rationale: 658 is a grammar-page reference embedded between the two imperative forms in turoyo. It is already present in refs, so remove only the embedded reference and retain both saq and isaq.

summary: I codes the mover as subject, with l-/ʕal- goals and b- route or destination (93/15,21). yasəqle/yasəqlan take animate goals as l-suffixes (112/277,284).
III has patient suffixes and full patient NPs. b- containers (JL 11.12/1; JL 17.5/12) contrast with b- class in academic promotion.
Infectum appears in past narrative (Hors 2/148; MAC NI Aḥmad Aġa Oṣman Aġa/57). Infectum-wa expresses repeated processing and counterfactual hauling (115/190).
Read-only slq lookup confirms related paradigms and an overlapping MAC acorn example. Keep inherited entries pending editorial review of their division; contracted məsq- is not exclusive to ysq.
No new light-verb idiom supported. Getting onto machinery, going up to replace the sun, loading and animal raising remain within sense 1.

Source aliases and bundled citations were checked: JL 9.10/13, JL 11.12/1, 11/99, 21/28, 27/11,66,67, 28/51, 60/91, 77/93, 81/15, 84/25, 115/190 and Talay 1/66,380 are already represented. No duplicated quotations added.

Round 1 already fills III Preterit to five; unfinished Presentation goal lu... and repeated bringing-up in Jan 3.21/481 add no necessary context. The full Mawsaqleli / contracted mosəqleli pair is selected for morphology only.
mawsaq-/mosəq-/məsq- remain under ysq as in the assigned entry and round 1. Jan also uses saləq/saliqina for the mover; this supports overlap with slq without authorizing merger of those entries.
Round-1 school-promotion III.2 is neither duplicated nor newly supported by this sample. No new lexical sense is accepted.
Should ysq and slq have reciprocal cross-references or a unified paradigm? Contracted məsq- also occurs under slq III.
Confirm Ksuqlo at PrS 50/89 before treating its spelling as paradigm evidence.
Confirm məsqole in 56/45 as contracted III Preterit rather than unprefixed narrative Infectum; retained provisionally, not quoted.
Do yasəq after kazze at 112/275 represent Preterit Intransitive in ongoing perception or an Infectum variant? Source vowels retained.
The supplied German at 52/152 omits the Isaq command; 88/116 omits explicit ascent. Withheld as aligned examples.
Does 1pl gyəsqina with ḥa mənayna in 27/66 reflect group agreement?
In Talay 1/380, inherited Infectum-wa quotation includes Preterit Intransitive yasiqi plus the relevant yəsqiwa; no move is needed.
Identify kəmyasqile (Jan 4.I/473) and yusqina (4.I/516) independently of their machine translations. Neither melting nor becoming fresh is established for ysq.
Confirm whether Barbana is a name transcription error for Barnaba (Jan 3.21/479); preserve source Barbana in the quotation.
Confirm person/suffix segmentation of mawsaqqe in the unfinished Jan 2.31/4991 clause; no new example is added.
Bird flight and snake movement preserve ascent; no separate locomotion senses.
Teeth extending upwards to the nose instantiate static spatial extent with an inanimate subject.
Human, animal, food and material patients; loading and mounting remain physical raising.
Angelic movers and Mary as patient retain upward transport. A religious scene does not require an independent Ascension sense.
